paper_title: Leveraging ChatGPT As Text Annotation Tool For Sentiment Analysis
caption: Accuracy of ChatGPT VS VADER and TextBlob
model_annotation: The chart illustrates the accuracy of three sentiment analysis tools, namely TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT, in analyzing two categories of tweets: "Emoji Tweets" and "Overall Tweets." The categories are represented on the horizontal axis, while the vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy" with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8 in intervals of 0.2. For each category, the accuracy of the three tools is represented by grouped bars, with TEXTBLOB in white, VADER in white with diagonal stripes, and ChatGPT in green. In the "Emoji Tweets" category, the accuracy values are approximately 0.33 for TEXTBLOB, 0.48 for VADER, and 0.67 for ChatGPT, while in the "Overall Tweets" category, the values are approximately 0.38 for TEXTBLOB, 0.44 for VADER, and 0.64 for ChatGPT. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
